serene-villa.name: Serene Villa
serene-villa.description: A four-bedroom villa with a private pool and quiet gardens, shaped to follow the natural contour of the land.
serene-villa.detail: Open living spaces flow onto the terrace and pool, while the primary suite faces a leafy garden. Morning light enters softly through wide openings.

canopy-villa.name: Canopy Villa
canopy-villa.description: A three-bedroom villa sheltered by trees, with solar panels and a quiet home office.
canopy-villa.detail: Designed for sustainable living, it combines cross ventilation, natural light, and a garden that blends into the interior.

lumen-villa.name: Lumen Villa
lumen-villa.description: A villa with a private spa area and hillside panoramas — for both quiet retreat and hosting guests.
lumen-villa.detail: Warm materials and soft lighting create a calming mood. The spa and pool become the heart of family relaxation.

ivory-terrace.name: Ivory Terrace
ivory-terrace.description: A three-bedroom residence with a green terrace and smart-home system — compact yet airy.
ivory-terrace.detail: An efficient plan makes the most of every metre. The terrace becomes an extra space to unwind in the afternoon.

saffron-court.name: Saffron Court
saffron-court.description: A residence with an inner garden, home office, and solar panels for more efficient living.
saffron-court.detail: Ideal for young families who value comfort alongside energy awareness.

meridian-garden.name: Meridian Garden
meridian-garden.description: A two-bedroom residence with shared gardens and a fitness room — a calm off-plan option.
meridian-garden.detail: As an off-plan unit, the plan and finishing can still be discussed to suit your needs.

skyline-crown.name: Skyline Crown
skyline-crown.description: A penthouse with a rooftop terrace and city panorama, with concierge support and security.
skyline-crown.detail: Generous living space opens onto the city all day long. The rooftop terrace is ideal for hosting guests in the evening.

celestia.name: Celestia Penthouse
celestia.description: A four-bedroom penthouse with a spa area, wine cellar, and a grand rooftop terrace.
celestia.detail: The pinnacle of our city collection — designed for special moments with the finest finishing details.

highland-manor.name: Highland Manor
highland-manor.description: A five-bedroom estate with generous grounds, a pool, gardens, and a wine cellar in cool highlands.
highland-manor.detail: This estate offers room for extended family and guests, with expansive gardens and fresh mountain air.

riverstone.name: Riverstone Estate
riverstone.description: A six-bedroom estate with a spa, fitness area, and wide gardens — an exclusive off-plan project.
riverstone.detail: As an off-plan project, Riverstone offers flexibility in plan and finishing to match your preferences.

azure-cliff.name: Azure Cliff Villa
azure-cliff.description: A cliffside villa with open panoramas, a pool, and a spa area that merges with the view.
azure-cliff.detail: Its elevated position offers a wide panorama that shifts throughout the day, from morning mist to evening light.

palma-grove.name: Palma Grove
palma-grove.description: A three-bedroom residence with a small pool, garden, and solar panels in a leafy neighbourhood.
palma-grove.detail: A blend of family comfort and efficiency, surrounded by a calm, green setting.

compliance.title: Disclosure & compliance
compliance.lead: We are committed to presenting information honestly and avoiding claims we cannot stand behind.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body:
This page explains how we present information, handle enquiries, and maintain disclosure.
Aurea Living is a demonstration brand. Names, imagery, prices, and figures on this site are illustrative and are not an official offer or a binding agreement.

disclosure.title: Information disclosure
disclosure.body:
We do not display certifications, awards, or affiliations that we do not hold.
Specifications, areas, and prices may differ from actual conditions and should be confirmed directly before any decision is made.

data.title: Data handling
data.body:
This site does not store your personal data on our servers. When you send an enquiry, the information is forwarded directly via WhatsApp or your chosen email app.
Further details are available on the Privacy Policy page.

payments.title: Enquiries & transactions
payments.body:
This site does not process online payments. All enquiries and commercial discussions happen directly via WhatsApp, phone, or email with our team.
Every transaction step is handled directly and transparently.

imagery.title: Imagery & visuals
imagery.body:
Home imagery on this site is illustrative visual content generated for demonstration purposes, not photographs of real property.
For production use, imagery would be replaced with official property photography.

contact.title: Contacting us
contact.body: For questions about compliance or the information on this site, please reach us through the channels on the Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: A brief, honest explanation of how your data is handled when you interact with this site.

collect.title: Data we receive
collect.body:
This site has no forms that store data on a server. When you use the contact form, the details you enter are composed into a message and sent via WhatsApp or your own email app.
So your data only travels through the channel you choose.

use.title: Use of data
use.body: Information you send via WhatsApp or email is used solely to respond to your enquiry and help with choosing a home.

share.title: Sharing data
share.body: We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing. Communication stays between you and our team.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site uses minimal technical cookies, for example to remember your language preference. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Because we do not store your data on this site, you keep full control over the WhatsApp or email conversation. You can delete it from your device at any time.

contact.title: Privacy questions
contact.body: If you have any privacy questions, please reach us through the channels on the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Terms for using the Aurea Living website.

use.title: Using the site
use.body: By accessing this site, you agree to use it for reasonable informational purposes. Content is provided as-is for demonstration.

listings.title: Residence information
listings.body: Home details, prices, areas, and imagery are illustrative and may change. No part of this site constitutes an official offer or a binding agreement.

inquiries.title: Enquiries
inquiries.body: Enquiries sent through the site are forwarded via WhatsApp or email. Responses are provided at the team's availability during working hours.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Names, designs, and materials on this site are used for demonstration. Any third-party marks or names belong to their respective owners.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: We strive to keep information accurate but do not guarantee that all content is free of errors. Decisions should be made after direct confirmation.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the applicable laws of Indonesia.
